posts.description: Judge Judy was on the screen, making the kind of faces you imagine Judge Judy making. I don’t watch her by choice, but it was lunch, and the TV was on, and I didn’t have the remote control. What struck me this time was how hard they try to make her look like she has the right to talk to people like she does. Her studio looks a lot like a real courtroom.
